Here are the Quarrendon Freight Lines (QFL) ticket numbers I found in Moss's notes:

1. **#4419**, gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. Source: "North cheat sheet (undated)" in Moss's notes. The same cheat sheet says it was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.
2. **#4419**, Gate 3 printer lag (bill-of-lading printout delay), with a patch pushed. Source: "Q2 expansion wrap (belated)," Marcus Lindqvist, 14 Jul 2025. This note describes the same number differently from the cheat sheet, so one of the two descriptions is probably wrong. Worth checking in the ticket system before it goes in the weekly notes.
3. **#PD-4492**, Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk alerts, where drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 weren't getting SMS bay assignments. Thea Ramaswell submitted it on 4 Oct 2025, and support patched it on 4 Oct. Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the 04:00 shift cleared. Source: "Sunday prep for Ruth," 5 Oct 2025. The same note asks that the kiosk logs be archived before the 14 Oct maintenance window.

The other QFL notes (the 2026 renewal check-in, the September 2025 pipeline digest, and the #inc-qfl-sev1 war room from 4 Nov 2025) don't include a ticket number. The #4409 and #4412 numbers in the January handoff note belong to a different account, so I left them out.

This is from a keyword search of GBrain, which doesn't run semantic matching right now. Notes phrased very differently might not have come up, so treat the list as what I could find rather than a complete audit.

I can't post to the weekly notes from here, so this is the list for you to paste in.
